exercises.q: Названа стоимость ___ (билеты) на поезд в Крым.
exercises.prompt: The price of train tickets to Crimea has been announced.
exercises.why: The genitive case has four main uses: to denote possession ('Michael's car', meaning 'the car of Michael'), to denote number ('five apples'), in negative constructions ('there are no books'), and after several important prepositions ('without me'). — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0). From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 23.  ·  «The genitive case is used to denote the possessor or owner … A noun in the genitive case is sometimes used to qualify (modify) another noun.» — DLI, Lesson 23.
